readings: For each distinct `budget.link_to_event`, calculate the average `spent` and average `remaining` across its budget lines, ignoring NULLs in each average. Subtract the average `remaining` across all budget lines, ignoring NULLs, from that event’s average `remaining`. Show the 10 events with the largest difference, sorted highest first with NULL differences last. Do not round.

For each distinct `budget.link_to_event`, calculate the average `spent` and average `remaining` across its budget lines, ignoring NULLs in each average. Calculate the overall average by taking the unweighted average of those per-event average `remaining` values, ignoring NULL event averages. Subtract that overall average from each event’s average `remaining`. Show the 10 events with the largest difference, sorted highest first with NULL differences last. Do not round.
queries:
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
    AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining,
    AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_difference
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event
ORDER BY remaining_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) AS avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
event_differences AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        avg_spent,
        avg_remaining,
        avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS difference
    FROM event_averages
)
SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, difference
FROM event_differences
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10
